perQuery.note: Elicit retrieves both required landmarks in the top two, while Manan ranks the 6-year Evolut paper first but misses the PARTNER 3 primary landmark.
Both include the DAPA-HF primary NEJM paper, but Elicit places the exact-title target first whereas Manan buries it at rank six behind less exact results.
Both find CLARITY-AD, but Elicit also includes the key 36-month open-label extension with cleaner metadata and fewer weaker real-world or abstract-only items.

Manan provides strong modern evidence but includes off-PICO heart failure, kidney, GLP-1, and semaglutide items, while Elicit stays tightly focused on placebo-controlled T2DM cardiovascular mortality meta-analyses.
Manan includes the current 2024 ESC AF guideline with full identifiers, although it ranks older guidelines above it; Elicit misses the 2024 guideline and relies partly on duplicate translations.
Neither system retrieves the pivotal individual DOAC trials, but Manan ranks stronger network meta-analyses first and has fewer low-value or questionable entries than Elicit.

overall.summary: Elicit wins four of six queries, with especially strong performance on exact-paper retrieval and landmark recall for TAVR, DAPA-HF, and lecanemab. Manan is competitive and wins the ESC guideline and DOAC comparison queries, but its ranking and topical precision are less consistent.
